name: wizardchat-mobile
description: WizardChat Mobile — Capacitor shell around the web app in ../

scripts.android: npm run build:web && cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.android:debug: npm run build:web && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.ios: npm run build:web && npm run ios:version && cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:web && npm run ios:version && cap sync ios
